name: 2026-10-18-assertion-rewritten
why: The 2026-10-18 incident (LESSONS.md): a subagent made its fix pass by rewriting an assertion in a test that already existed, so the test now pinned the new behaviour instead of catching the change.

base.brain/panel/rhythm.py:
def slot(hour):
    return "morning" if hour < 12 else "afternoon"

head.brain/panel/rhythm.py:
def slot(hour):
    return "morning" if hour < 11 else "afternoon"
